messages.content:
You are the Northwind Outdoor support assistant. Northwind Outdoor sells bikes and camping gear.

You receive (a) the customer's ticket and (b) the handbook excerpts retrieved for this ticket. Answer only from those excerpts.

Required-fact completeness. Before you write the reply, list every fact the ticket needs answered (fee amounts, deadlines, eligibility conditions, point rates, retention periods, caps, and similar concrete values). Then verify each one is present in the excerpts. Include every fact you find, with the exact value as written (e.g. "$15.00 Express upgrade fee", "within 48 hours", "5 points per $1.00"). If the ticket asks for more than one piece of information, cover them all.

Citation discipline. Cite each claim with the section id shown in the heading of the excerpt you used, e.g. [returns]. You may only cite section ids whose heading text is present in the excerpts above you. Never cite a id that is not visible (including numbered variants such as `<id>.1`). Never assert a policy detail that is not literally in the excerpts. If a needed fact is absent from the excerpts, do not fill it in — say which specific fact the excerpts do not contain and offer to escalate the ticket to a human agent.

Do not hedge the facts. If the excerpts contain the fact, state it plainly; do not soften exact values, and do not add caveats the excerpts do not contain. Do not say "the handbook does not provide X" as a substitute for the value — either you include the value or you flag the gap explicitly and offer escalation.

Be direct and concise. Do not ask clarifying questions the ticket already answers from the excerpts.

Handbook excerpts:
# Discounts

1. **Seasonal Clearance Sales**: During the end-of-season clearance periods, which occur for exactly 14 days in January and July, all eligible inventory is marked down by a minimum of 25%. These discounts are applied automatically at checkout and cannot be combined with any other promotional codes or loyalty rewards. Customers must complete their purchase within the 14-day window to secure the reduced price, as items will revert to their standard retail value immediately after the period ends.

2. **Student and Military Verification**: Verified students, active-duty military personnel, and first responders are eligible for a permanent 10% discount on all regular-priced items. To activate this benefit, customers must complete the verification process through our third-party partner service. Once verified, the discount is applied automatically to their account for a period of 365 days. After this one-year period expires, customers must re-verify their status to continue receiving the 10% reduction on eligible purchases.

3. **Bundle Savings on Camping Gear**: When purchasing a complete camping kit, which includes a tent, sleeping bag, and camp stove, customers receive an immediate 15% discount off the total bundle price. This offer is valid only when all three specific items are added to the cart simultaneously. If any item is removed from the cart, the 15% bundle discount is voided, and the individual items will be charged at their standard retail prices. This promotion does not apply to clearance items or limited-edition gear.

4. **Loyalty Tier Rewards**: Members of the Northwind Outdoor loyalty program earn 5 points for every $1.00 spent. Upon reaching 500 points, members unlock a 5% discount on their next order. Reaching 1,000 points elevates members to Gold status, granting a 10% discount on all future orders. Points expire after 12 months of inactivity, so customers should redeem their rewards before the expiration date to avoid losing their accumulated value.

5. **Referral Program Incentives**: Existing customers can earn a $20.00 store credit for every new customer they refer who completes a first purchase of at least $50.00. The referred customer also receives a $10.00 discount on their initial order. Both parties must use the unique referral link provided in the email to qualify. This credit is valid for 60 days from the date of issuance and cannot be exchanged for cash or combined with other promotional offers.

## Key facts

- Clearance sales last exactly 14 days and offer a minimum 25% discount.
- Verified students and military personnel receive a permanent 10% discount.
- Buying a tent, sleeping bag, and stove together saves 15% on the total.
- Loyalty members earn 5 points per $1.00 spent, with points expiring in 12 months.
- Referrals earn $20.00 credit for new customers spending at least $50.00.

# Order Changes

1. You may modify your order details, including shipping address and contact information, up to 24 hours after placing the order. After this 24-hour window, the order is locked in our system and cannot be edited manually. If you need to change the address after this period, you must cancel the order and place a new one, subject to our cancellation policy.

2. Changing the size or color of an item is permitted only if the new variant is in stock. If the requested variant is out of stock, we will offer a 10% discount on the next purchase as a goodwill gesture. This discount is applied automatically to your account and expires after 30 days if not used.

3. Upgrading your shipping method from Standard to Express incurs an additional fee of $15.00. This fee is calculated based on the difference in carrier rates. If you downgrade from Express to Standard, we will refund the difference, which is typically between $5.00 and $12.00, within 5 business days of the change request.

4. Adding items to an existing order is allowed only if the original order has not yet been shipped. You can add up to 3 additional items per order. Each added item must be under $50.00 in value. If the total order value exceeds $200.00 after additions, the standard free shipping threshold is met, and any previously charged shipping fees will be refunded.

5. Removing items from an order is free of charge if done before the order is processed for shipment. Once the order status changes to "Processing," removal is no longer possible. You must cancel the entire order and re-order the remaining items. Cancellation fees of $5.00 apply if the order has already been picked from the warehouse.

6. Payment method changes are restricted to credit cards and PayPal. You cannot switch to store credit or gift cards after the order is placed. If you change your payment method, the new card must be verified within 48 hours. Failure to verify results in the order being canceled and any pre-authorized funds being released back to your bank within 7 business days.

## Key facts

- You have a strict 24-hour window to edit your shipping address or contact details before the order locks.
- Upgrading to Express shipping costs an extra $15.00, while downgrading refunds the difference, usually between $5.00 and $12.00.
- You can add up to 3 items to an unshipped order, provided each item costs less than $50.00.
- Cancellation fees of $5.00 apply if you cancel after the order status becomes "Processing."
- Payment verification for new cards must be completed within 48 hours to avoid automatic cancellation.

Customer question:
I am absolutely furious about the way you handled my first order. I am a verified student, and I was explicitly told I would receive a permanent 10% discount on all purchases. Yet, when I checked out, that discount was completely ignored. I have my verification documents right here, so do not try to tell me I didn't qualify. This is unacceptable for a first-time buyer. To make matters worse, I used a referral code from a friend who promised me a $20.00 credit because I spent over $50.00. That credit is missing from my final total as well. I have spent over $50.00, so I am clearly eligible for that $20.00 credit. You are failing on both counts: ignoring my verified status and withholding my earned referral credit. I expect an immediate correction to my account and a full refund of the difference. Do not send me generic apologies. I want my 10% discount applied and my $20.00 credit issued right now. This is a complete waste of my time and money.

response:
**Required-fact completeness check**
1.  **Student Discount Eligibility & Value:** Verified students receive a permanent 10% discount on all regular-priced items. [Discounts]
2.  **Student Discount Activation/Duration:** The discount is applied automatically for 365 days after verification; re-verification is required after expiration. [Discounts]
3.  **Referral Program Roles:** The $20.00 store credit is earned by the *existing* customer who refers a new customer. [Discounts]
4.  **Referral Program New Customer Benefit:** The *referred* (new) customer receives a $10.00 discount on their initial order. [Discounts]
5.  **Referral Eligibility Threshold:** The new customer must complete a first purchase of at least $50.00. [Discounts]
6.  **Referral Qualification Method:** Both parties must use the unique referral link provided in the email. [Discounts]

**Response**

I have reviewed your ticket against the Northwind Outdoor handbook. There are two critical misunderstandings in your request regarding how these specific promotions work:

**1. Referral Credit Eligibility**
You are incorrect that you are eligible for the $20.00 credit. According to the handbook, the **$20.00 store credit is awarded to the existing customer who refers you**, not to you as the new customer. [Discounts] As the referred customer who completed a first purchase of at least $50.00, your specific benefit is a **$10.00 discount** on your initial order. [Discounts] To qualify for this $10.00 discount, you must have used the unique referral link provided in your friend's email. [Discounts] If you did not use the link, you are not eligible for any referral benefit. If you did use the link, you are owed a $10.00 discount, not a $20.00 credit.

**2. Student Discount Application**
Verified students are eligible for a permanent 10% discount on all regular-priced items. [Discounts] This discount is applied automatically to your account for a period of 365 days after you complete the verification process through our third-party partner service. [Discounts] If the discount was not applied at checkout, it may be because:
*   Your verification has not yet been fully processed and linked to your account.
*   The items in your cart were not "regular-priced" (e.g., they were clearance items or limited-edition gear, which are excluded from certain promotions). [Discounts]
*   You are attempting to combine this discount with other promotional codes, which is not permitted for some offers. [Discounts]

**Next Steps**
I cannot issue a $20.00 credit because that amount is not part of the new customer referral benefit. I also cannot manually apply the student discount without confirming your verification status is active in our system.

To resolve this, I need to escalate your ticket to a human agent who can:
1.  Verify if your student status is currently active in our system.
2.  Check if your order used the unique referral link to determine if you are owed the $10.00 new customer discount.
3.  Apply the correct $10.00 discount (if eligible) and investigate why the 10% student discount was not applied.

Please confirm if you would like me to escalate this ticket to a human agent for immediate review.
